scientific_integrity: Proof includes exact density-ratio derivative, Jensen normalization, all-degree interval signs, Student/Gaussian tail comparison and endpoint constant. Finite spot checks are not completeness proofs.
scientific_limitations: No monotonicity across degrees or global stochastic ordering; boundary is variance-normalized and uniqueness concerns central intervals. Independent priority assessment remains necessary.
title: Exact central-mass crossing and variance-edge escape for standardized Student laws
